title: Public CORS RINEX to SPP vs RTK with RTKLIB demo5 and gnss_lib_py
summary: Downloads one day of public NOAA NGS CORS RINEX for a rover/base pair 30 km apart, runs RTKLIB demo5 rnx2rtkp in single-point and kinematic RTK modes with exact CLI flags, and scores both against the stations' published ITRF2020 coordinates (propagated for plate motion) in ENU. An optional gnss_lib_py weighted-least-squares SPP covers the same data in Python, after converting RINEX 2.11 to 3.
verified: unverified sketch: syntax-checked only (bash -n, py_compile); requires RTKLIB demo5 rnx2rtkp/convbin, crx2rnx, and gnss-lib-py. rnx2rtkp/convbin flags were checked against demo5 v2.5.1 source help text and gnss_lib_py calls against v1.1.0 source on 2026-11-06. The stdlib scorer compare_pos.py and its 4 unit tests ran with python3.14.7 on 2026-11-06, and its coordinate parser ran on the real downloaded NGS sheets; the data URLs returned HTTP 200 and the P730 RINEX header was inspected. No RTKLIB or gnss_lib_py solution was computed.
